analyst.summary: Sammaan Capital (formerly Indiabulls Housing Finance) reported an enormous quarterly loss, but it appears to be driven almost entirely by one-time accounting charges tied to Abu Dhabi-based IHC Group's USD 1 billion strategic investment completing in March 2026, rather than a breakdown in the core lending business, whose reported asset quality was healthy just before this transaction closed. The stock now trades close to book value, suggesting the market has already absorbed the hit. Given how large and consequential this single item is, we recommend the CIO or PM personally verify the accounting details behind the loss before treating this as either a clean bill of health or a red flag.
